ai.en: Moonlight Sonata on Sunday 13 December at St George's Hall is a one-hour programme of Beethoven's Moonlight Sonata and works by Chopin and Liszt.

events.description: PROGRAMME: Beethoven – Moonlight Sonata Chopin – Selected Works Liszt – Selected Works ABOUT: At the heart of this one-hour programme is Beethoven’s Moonlight Sonata, one of the most famous and haunting works ever written for piano. The work acquired its famous nickname after it was likened to moonlight shining on Lake Lucerne by a famous poet of the time. Unlike other piano sonatas, Beethoven begins with a hushed, almost hypnotic opening, built on a gently undulating accompaniment, before moving through a lighter middle movement and culminating in a turbulent, dramatic finale — a movement of extraordinary intensity and drive that pushes the piano to its limits. The programme also includes music by Chopin and Liszt, two composers who expanded the expressive and technical possibilities of the piano in very different ways.

ai.en: Day Fever, a daytime clubbing event started by Vicky McClure, Jonny Owen and Reverend & The Makers, takes place at Camp and Furnace in Liverpool.

events.description: DAY FEVER HAS TAKEN OVER THE COUNTRY! The day-time clubbing event started by Vicky McClure, Jonny Owen and Reverend & The Makers has swept the UK since it’s launch in 2024 ‘The day-time disco that doesn’t ruin your Sunday’ has amassed a huge following with thousands of punters packing out clubs and theatres every weekend to dance the day away from. A whole generation who perhaps thought their clubbing days were behind them are blazing a trail for a new way to enjoy themselves. Day Fever prides itself on creating a safe-space where people can just be themselves. No dress code, no egos, just enjoyment and positivity. This has seen a loyal fanbase leading to sold out shows in some of the countries most famous venues. The music policy is simple, the greatest hits of the 20th century. Why can’t Madonna sit next to Madness? Pulp go back to back with Prince? The Stone Roses and The Rolling Stones? 90’s dance classics versus a spot of Motown? Why choose when you can enjoy it all? Vicky McClure says ‘Travelling up and down the country and seeing so many people enjoying themselves has been such a joy, we’re just so happy that people feel comfortable at Day Fever and meeting and hearing everyone’s stories has made us realise how important it is for us all to take some time out of life and just have a bloody good dance!’ Follow DAY FEVER on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X - @DAYFEVERUK OVER 18S ONLY/ID REQ, NO BAGS BIGGER THAN A4 SIZE

Alongside the orchestra, live vocalist will embody the voices of Tolkien’s world — from ethereal Elvish laments to the haunting chants of ancient realms, bringing a deeply emotional and otherworldly dimension to the music of The Lord of the Rings. Scientist soon became the prinicipal engineer at Channel One releasing a series of classic albums in the early 1980's such as Scientist meets the Space Invaders, Scientific Dub, Scientists wins the World Cup, Scientist Encounters Pac-Man, Scientist and Jammy Strike Back and Scientist Rids the World of the Evil Curse of the Vampires. ai.en: Snayx, a trio based in Brighton and Sheffield, performs at District.

events.description: SNAYX were formed from a mosh pit. Sure, the Brighton & Sheffield based trio have been in other bands before, dabbling in everything from indie rock to ska, but those groups never incited the communal carnage that Charlie Herridge, Ollie Horner and Lainey Loops crave. So they formed SNAYX, originally a two-piece, now a three. For a good chunk of time though, SNAYX was more of an idea than an actual band since the pair were too busy going to as many gigs as possible, rather than working on things like songs. They’d talk about SNAYX to anyone who would listen though, hungry to be part of the scene. And then in the smoking area of a Brighton venue, Hastings punks Kid Kapichi invited them to open for them. Of course, SNAYX said yes, despite the fact they didn’t have a finished song between them. That changed over a frantic few days, where all of those conversations about ethos, influence and intention quickly turned into a furious 30-minutes of music.The gig went better than it had any right to, and SNAYX were born. A series of support slots followed, alongside a very DIY headline tour. “That’s when everything clicked into place,” says Charlie. “Onstage we really understood what it was, and what it could be.

events.description: AGMP Presents Martin Stephenson & The Daintees hail from the North East of England. Their debut single 'Roll On Summertime' was released in 1982 on Kitchenware Records (home of Prefab Sprout, The Kane Gang, Hurrah!). 'Boat To Bolivia' was the debut album by Martin Stephenson & The Daintees. After appearances on Channel 4's 'The Tube' and BBC2's 'Whistle Test' the album went on to become one of the essential releases of 1986. In 1988, the second Martin Stephenson & The Daintees album 'Gladsome, Humour & Blue' was released which featured the singles 'There Comes A Time' & 'Wholly Humble Heart'. Don't miss Martin Stephenson & The Daintees perform music from the 'Gladsome, Humour & Blue' LP along with other classics and fan favourites. An AGMP Concerts presentation.

events.description: An Evening With Chicane - Liverpool Saturday 3rd April 2027 The Dome, Grand Central Hall Join us in April as the legendary Chicane returns to Liverpool with an evening of balearic beats & an extended set for another sell out headline show. Chicane is often seen as one of, if not the seminal Trance originator. With the track Offshore he refined cool in the dance genre, the name Chicane became synonymous with Ibiza and sunsets, and quality music, an aural security blanket. Saltwater followed on and became a UK top five hit. Worldwide success was sealed with a collaboration between Chicane and Bryan Adams, Don't Give Up from the hit album Behind the Sun. The track has reached the number one spot on the UK Singles Chart. Now recognised as a dancefloor classic, it was one of the first dance collaboration tracks to reach such heights. In addition to his work as Chicane the artist, he has worked with and produced music with Cher, Sir Tom Jones, William Orbit, Natasha Bedingfield and composed for TV and film. Tickets for this are extremely limited. Secure yours before its too late!

ai.en: RUTS DC present 50 years of The Ruts, celebrating their music from 1977 to 2027, at The Crossing with special guests.

events.description: RUTS DC present 50 years of RUTS Music (1977-2027) THE RUTS + special guests In 1977, The Ruts emerged from London with a sound unlike anybody else around them - the raw urgency of punk colliding with reggae, dub and rock, driven by formidable musicianship and a fierce sense of purpose. With Malcolm Owen, Paul Fox, Dave Ruffy and Segs Jennings, The Ruts created a body of music whose power has endured far beyond its original moment. After losing Malcolm Owen in 1980, the remaining members chose integrity over nostalgia by re-inventing themselves as Ruts DC, eventually losing Paul Fox in 2007. Ruts DC remain a living, evolving band to this day. But the time has come to celebrate the whole story. This tour is about taking the music that exploded out of a movement and bringing it onto a stage in 2027 with all its urgency and relevance intact. Music made across five decades - from the albums The Crack and Grin & Bear It, through Animal Now, Rhythm Collision, Music Must Destroy, and Counterculture? with the classic singles In A Rut. Babylon's Burning. Something That I Said. Jah War. Staring At The Rude Boys. West One (Shine On Me) and more. An AGMP Concerts presentation. This event is for over 18s only - No refunds will be issued for under 18s

AGMP Presents AGMP Concerts present NINE BELOW ZERO featuring Ben Waters Dennis Greaves and Mark Feltham are the founding members of Nine Below Zero. They started making music and playing live together in South East London back in 1977. Celebrating 50 years of creating and playing some of the finest UK Rhythm 'n' Blues, Nine Below Zero are embarking on a bespoke European Tour in 2027, with very special guests joining them on stage, including legendary The Jam bassist Bruce Foxton, fast-rising Zac Schulze, incredible blues pianist Ben Waters, guitarist Robbie McIntosh and Rhythm 'n' Blues legends Dr. Feelgood. Nine Below Zero released their classic debut LP Live at the Marquee in 1980, kept the momentum going with Don't Point Your Finger in 1981 before releasing their third LP on A&M Records, Third Degree (1982). The front cover image for 'Third Degree' was shot by legendary photographer, David Bailey. Since 1988 they have released a further 20 LP's in an incredible career. Mark Feltham has also been selected as harmonica-player by a whole host of acts including Oasis, Annie Lennox, Talk Talk and Rory Gallagher. Dennis Greaves formed the mod group The Truth who found chart and live success throughout the 1980's. Nine Below Zero toured with The Who and The Kinks in the early 80's and also appeared onThe Old Grey Whistle Test, The South Bank Show and perhaps most memorably, a cameo performance on the first ever episode of cult comedy The Young Ones performing 'Eleven + Eleven'…

AGMP Presents XTC's legendary drummer, Terry Chambers, is back on the road with his band EXTC (named and approved by XTC frontman, Andy Partridge). Emerging out of the post-punk and new-wave explosion of the late 70s, XTC experienced global success touring with the likes of The Police and Talking Heads. Sadly, their legions of loyal fans would be left in limbo when in 1982 XTC stopped touring, becoming a studio-based entity. EXTC were formed in 2019 by XTC's drummer Terry Chambers, performing classic XTC material such as Making Plans For Nigel, Senses Working Overtime, Mayor of Simpleton, Generals and Majors, Sgt. Rock (Is Going To Help Me), Love on a Farmboy's Wages and many more. An AGMP Concerts presentation.

Fresh from scoring their first-ever UK Number 1 album with You Got This, Newport legends Skindred are bringing their explosive live show to Liverpool Olympia on Friday 7th May 2027, joined by special guests The Skinner Brothers! For over two decades, the MOBO and Heavy Music Award winners have proved that no band sounds quite like them. Fusing reggae, metal, punk, rock and electronic influences into a genre-defying sound entirely their own, Skindred have built a reputation as one of Britain’s most electrifying live acts and one of modern rock’s great success stories. Their relentless touring, headlining slots at Wembley Arena and celebrated appearances at Glastonbury and Later… with Jools Holland have cemented their status as a true powerhouse of British music. At the centre of it all stands frontman Benji Webbe, whose boundless enthusiasm and unwavering belief in people have become just as iconic as the band’s music. Expect a high-energy Friday night packed with colossal riffs, irresistible hooks and dancehall grooves, featuring massive anthems like Nobody and Gimme That Boom alongside tracks from their chart-topping ninth album. Whether you are a lifelong fan or ready to experience the legendary Newport Helicopter for the first time, this is one night at Liverpool Olympia you do not want to miss – secure your tickets now!
